diagrams.title: SysML Block Definition Diagram (BDD): OtaconsKeep blocks, parts, values, ports
diagrams.notes: SysML BDD rendered in Mermaid classDiagram. Blocks use <<block>> stereotype. Composition edges are part relationships. Value/port properties listed in compartments. ASCII stereotypes used for Mermaid 10 compatibility (guillemets break the parser).

diagrams.title: SysML Internal Block Diagram (IBD): parts, ports, connectors, item flows
diagrams.mermaid:
flowchart TB
  subgraph SYS["block OtaconsKeep IBD"]
    direction TB
    subgraph ARB["part AgentRuntime"]
      ARP_IN((p_msg))
      ARP_OUT((p_ctx))
    end
    subgraph MEMB["part Memory"]
      MEMP((p_store))
    end
    subgraph ECB["part EmotionalContinuity"]
      ECP((p_obs))
    end
    subgraph REB["part RelationshipEngine"]
      REP((p_rel))
    end
    subgraph MRB["part ModelRouter"]
      MRP_IN((p_req))
      MRP_OUT((p_inf))
    end
    subgraph MRTB["part ModelRuntime"]
      MRTP((p_ollama))
    end
    subgraph TLB["part ToolLayer"]
      TLP((p_tool))
    end
    subgraph PERB["part Persistence"]
      PERP((p_fs))
    end
    subgraph UIB["part WebUI"]
      UIP((p_http))
    end
  end
  U[actor User] -->|IF-002 Message JSON| UIP
  UIP <-->|API Message| ARP_IN
  ARP_OUT -->|ObserveEvent| ECP
  ARP_OUT -->|Retrieve Store| MEMP
  ARP_OUT -->|CapabilityRequest| MRP_IN
  MRP_OUT -->|IF-001 InferenceRequest| MRTP
  ARP_OUT -->|ToolCall| TLP
  MEMP <-->|StateBlob| PERP
  ARP_OUT -->|BondUpdate| REP
  REX[part REX] -.->|Job| TLP
  INST[part Installer] -->|IF-003 OS Feature Ops| OS[external WSL OS]
  MRTP -.->|optional| EP[external Providers]
diagrams.notes: SysML IBD: part usages inside the OtaconsKeep boundary, circular nodes as ports, edges as connectors with typed item flows. ASCII labels for Mermaid 10 compatibility.

diagrams.title: UML Sequence: user conversation lifecycle
diagrams.mermaid:
sequenceDiagram
 participant U as User
 participant UI as Web UI
 participant AR as Agent Runtime
 participant MR as Model Router
 participant M as Model
 participant MEM as Memory
 participant EC as Emotional Continuity
 U->>UI: message
 UI->>AR: request
 AR->>EC: observe_message
 AR->>MEM: retrieve context
 AR->>MR: route capability
 MR->>M: inference
 M-->>AR: completion
 AR->>MEM: store
 AR-->>UI: response
 UI-->>U: render

diagrams.title: UML Sequence: REX lifecycle
diagrams.mermaid:
sequenceDiagram
 participant D as Detect
 participant P as Propose
 participant R as Review/Authorize
 participant E as Execute
 participant V as Verify
 participant C as Close
 participant L as Learn
 D->>P: draft proposal
 P->>R: approval gate
 R->>E: approved item
 E->>V: done + evidence
 V->>C: verified or failed
 C->>L: outcome signal

diagrams.title: SysML Activity: installation
diagrams.mermaid:
flowchart TD
 A[Download Setup] --> B[Prerequisite detection]
 B --> C[Dependency installation]
 C --> D{WSL reboot needed?}
 D -->|yes| E[Reboot]
 E --> F[Resume Setup]
 D -->|no| F
 F --> G[Configuration]
 G --> H[Model / runtime setup]
 H --> I[Service setup]
 I --> J[Health check]
 J --> K[Completion]

diagrams.title: SysML Activity: failure / recovery
diagrams.mermaid:
flowchart TD
 A[Detect failure] --> B[Classify]
 B --> C[Recovery action]
 C --> D[Retest / health check]
 D -->|success| E[Resume operations]
 D -->|fail| F[Escalate / document]

diagrams.title: SysML Activity: agent request handling
diagrams.mermaid:
flowchart TD
 A[Receive request] --> B[Auth / login gate]
 B --> C[Assemble context]

 D --> E[Route model]
 E --> F[Execute tools if needed]

diagrams.title: SysML State Machine: REX proposal states
diagrams.mermaid:
stateDiagram-v2
 [*] --> Draft
 Draft --> Approved
 Draft --> Rejected
 Approved --> Executing
 Executing --> Done
 Executing --> Failed
 Done --> Verifying
 Verifying --> Verified
 Verifying --> VerifyFailed
 Verifying --> Unverifiable
 Verified --> Closed
 Failed --> Closed
 Rejected --> [*]
 Closed --> [*]

diagrams.title: SysML State Machine: emotional stage labels
diagrams.mermaid:
stateDiagram-v2
 [*] --> calm
 calm --> low
 low --> moderate
 moderate --> jealous_hurt
 moderate --> defensive
 defensive --> high_anger
 high_anger --> disengaged
 jealous_hurt --> moderate: repair
 defensive --> moderate: repair
 disengaged --> moderate: genuine_repair

diagrams.title: V-Model: left-side definition to right-side verification

flowchart LR
 UN[User Needs] --- VAL[Validation]

diagrams.title: MBSE verification chain: Need → Requirement → Architecture → Model → Verification → Evidence
diagrams.mermaid:
flowchart TB
 N[Stakeholder Need] --> R[requirement System Requirement]
 R -->|satisfy| B[block Design Element]
 B --> I[Implementation]
 R -->|verify| VC[Verification Case]
 VC --> M[Method TAID]
 VC --> E[Evidence]
 E --> RES[Result]
 B -.->|allocatedTo| VC

diagrams.title: SysML Parametric: emotion constraints
diagrams.mermaid:
flowchart TB
 subgraph Constraints
 C1["clamp: 0 ≤ x ≤ 1"]
 C2["_blend(+Δ) accrues"]
 C3["_blend(-Δ) * (1-ι)"]
 C4["decay: λ * min(12, Δt/90)"]
 C5["ΔJ = 0.16 sc (1+0.12 min(6,n))"]
 end
 E["E = [I,J,H,T,A,C,X]"] --> C1
 E --> C2
 E --> C3
 E --> C4
 Event[comparison] --> C5 --> J[J via _blend]
 P[Personality ι, sc, sr] --> C2
 P --> C3
